## What you should be able to do tonight

- State the change in each strategy's Sharpe after the rebuild and attribute it to specific taxonomy entries.
- Reproduce the look-ahead taxonomy from memory to at least eight entries.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>40 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [25 min]{.task-min} Finish anything outstanding from days 134 to 139, then write the correction into reports/milestone-03-pairs.md: the old number, the new number, and which look-ahead mechanism accounted for most of the difference. Superseding your own result in writing is the habit worth building here.

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arithmetic, timed, twentieth sitting. Ten two-digit multiplications, the sevenths, and 1/7 through 1/13 to three decimals.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Random walk maximum: a symmetric random walk runs for 100 steps. What is the expected maximum? Use the reflection principle to get the distribution of the maximum first, and say the argument out loud rather than writing it.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Arcsine law, stated as an interview question: over a long fair coin-flipping game, what is the most likely fraction of time spent ahead? Most people say one half. Say the right answer and the shape of the distribution.
:::
:::
